name: agentic-platform
description: Reusable agentic workload platform: AgentCore Harness + Step Functions constructs, plan schema, planner-driven workflows

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentic-platform/plan-schema && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/constructs && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/tools && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/api && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/webapp && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/example-marketing-workflow && npm run build -w @agentic-platform/example-second-workload
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/plan-schema && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/constructs && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/tools && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/api && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/example-marketing-workflow && npm run test -w @agentic-platform/example-second-workload
